scripts.build: tsc -p orchestrator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p mcp-server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p agent/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tui/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p orchestrator/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p orchestrator/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p mcp-server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p mcp-server/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p agent/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p agent/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tui/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p orchestrator/tsconfig.test.json && node --test orchestrator/dist-test/test/*.test.js && tsc -p mcp-server/tsconfig.test.json && node --test mcp-server/dist-test/test/*.test.js && tsc -p agent/tsconfig.test.json && node --test agent/dist-test/test/*.test.js && tsc -p tui/tsconfig.test.json && node --test tui/dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
